params.prompt: Photorealistic restaurant menu food photograph, 3/4 angle from slightly above. A large flour-tortilla burrito in foil, peeled back and cut open to show the filling: chopped grilled carne asada, golden french fries, melted cheddar cheese, pico de gallo, sour cream and orange chipotle aioli. The food sits on the red-painted wooden counter of a walk-up food stand in Los Angeles. Bright natural afternoon sunlight with crisp soft shadows, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field; background softly blurred warm red and brick tones with a hint of colorful cut-paper banners. Tack-sharp focus, true-to-life textures and natural color, appetizing, real street-food look, not over-styled. No text, no logos, no labels, no people, no hands.
